Get started with ColdNerd

Why Instagram works for freelancers

  • Your future clients — creators, coaches and small businesses — are active on Instagram.
  • You can see exactly what they need from their content before reaching out.
  • Your own portfolio is one tap away from your DM.
  • No platform fees or bidding wars like on freelance marketplaces.

A client-finding routine that runs itself

  1. Pick a niche. For example: 'video editing for fitness coaches' beats 'video editing for anyone'.
  2. Discover prospects. Pull prospects from niche hashtags and followers of accounts your clients follow.
  3. Send a value-first DM. Point out a specific improvement or idea for their content and ask if they'd like to see more.
  4. Follow up automatically. ColdNerd sends polite follow-ups and stops as soon as someone replies.
  5. Convert on a call. Spend your time on interested prospects, not on finding them.

Start small, scale when you're ready

The Starter plan includes 3 Instagram accounts, prospect discovery, AI personalization, follow-ups and 3,000 DMs per month — plenty for a solo freelancer. When you're ready to scale, Growth unlocks 15 accounts, full AI profile analysis and unlimited DMs.

Frequently asked questions

Which plan is best for freelancers?

Most freelancers start on Starter. Upgrade to Growth if you want more accounts, full AI profile analysis or unlimited DMs.

Do I need a business account?

A professional or creator account is recommended because it makes your profile look credible to prospects.

How much time does ColdNerd save?

It removes most manual work — finding prospects, writing first messages and remembering follow-ups — so you only handle replies.
